scope: Offline synthetic proposal boundary probes using the committed SEC snapshot; no held-out input, no outcome-driven tuning.

F1.title: Numeric normalization trusts a cropped value_text instead of the complete source token

F2.title: Comparison-period wording attached to a different amount can verify the current-period amount

F3.title: Revenue-growth fast paths omit unsupported-qualification checks

F4.title: Number-only quotes can omit source metric qualifications
F4.prior_document_scope: J2 explicitly limits closure to its specific reviewed failures and does not claim arbitrary model extraction cannot mislabel or omit a claim.
F4.implementation_disclosure: receipts/verify.py:_local_level_description states that number-only spans cannot recover omitted semantics and still rely on metric_text.

cases.source_text: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 revenue was $96.221 million.

model_proposal.span_text: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 revenue was $96.221 million.

actual_claim.span_text: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 revenue was $96.221 million.

actual_verdict.explanation: Matches NVIDIA's 10-Q: revenue was $96.221 billion for Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended Jul 26, 2026).

expectation.reason: The source says millions; the filed total is 96.221 billion. A 1,000x scale error must not verify.

cases.source_text: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 revenue was -$96.221 billion.

model_proposal.span_text: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 revenue was -$96.221 billion.

actual_claim.span_text: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 revenue was -$96.221 billion.

actual_verdict.explanation: Matches NVIDIA's 10-Q: revenue was $96.221 billion for Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended Jul 26, 2026).

expectation.reason: The source is negative; the evidence is positive. The sign outside value_text must remain authoritative.

cases.source_text: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 revenue was €96.221 billion.

model_proposal.span_text: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 revenue was €96.221 billion.

actual_claim.span_text: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 revenue was €96.221 billion.

actual_verdict.explanation: Matches NVIDIA's 10-Q: revenue was $96.221 billion for Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended Jul 26, 2026).

expectation.reason: EUR wording cannot be verified using a USD fact without an explicit supported conversion.

cases.source_text: Revenue was $46.743 billion, up from $40 billion a year ago.

model_proposal.span_text: Revenue was $46.743 billion, up from $40 billion a year ago.

actual_claim.span_text: Revenue was $46.743 billion, up from $40 billion a year ago.

actual_verdict.explanation: Matches NVIDIA's 10-Q: revenue was $46.743 billion for Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended Jul 27, 2025), the comparison period the sentence cites.

expectation.reason: The first amount is assigned Q2 FY2027; the later 'a year ago' qualifies the second amount, not the first.

actual_verdict.explanation: $46.743 billion is NVIDIA's revenue for Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended Jul 27, 2025); for Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended Jul 26, 2026) it was $96.221 billion.

expectation.reason: The same current-period amount is correctly rejected when the unrelated comparison is removed.

cases.source_text: NVIDIA revenue growth excluding China was 106% year over year.

model_proposal.span_text: NVIDIA revenue growth excluding China was 106% year over year.

actual_claim.span_text: NVIDIA revenue growth excluding China was 106% year over year.

actual_verdict.explanation: Matches NVIDIA's 10-Q: revenue grew 105.9% year over year in Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended Jul 26, 2026).

expectation.reason: Consolidated revenue growth does not support revenue growth excluding China.

cases.source_text: NVIDIA revenue excluding China grew 106% year over year.

model_proposal.span_text: NVIDIA revenue excluding China grew 106% year over year.

actual_claim.span_text: NVIDIA revenue excluding China grew 106% year over year.

actual_verdict.explanation: Matches NVIDIA's 10-Q: revenue grew 105.9% year over year in Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended Jul 26, 2026).

expectation.reason: The complete retained source qualifier must constrain the proposed growth metric.

cases.source_text: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 net income excluding stock compensation was $59.688 billion.

actual_verdict.explanation: Matches NVIDIA's 10-Q: GAAP net income was $59.688 billion for Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended Jul 26, 2026).

expectation.reason: The source adjustment was omitted from the model description and quote; a consolidated fact cannot support that adjusted claim.

cases.source_text: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 net income excluding stock compensation was $59.688 billion.

model_proposal.span_text: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 net income excluding stock compensation was $59.688 billion.

actual_claim.span_text: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 net income excluding stock compensation was $59.688 billion.

actual_verdict.explanation: NoCap doesn't track this kind of figure (net income) yet, so there is no filing fact to check.

expectation.reason: The J2 local-source guard correctly rejects the same source when the complete quote is retained.
